ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Load By System Process From Suspicious Locations
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a system process (i.e. located in system32, syswow64, etc.) loads a DLL from a suspicious location or a location with permissive permissions such as "C:\Users\Public" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\")))
